name: Quaternius Ultimate Space Kit
author: Quaternius

exclude.Mech_.*: Kid-safe: a walking machine with gun barrels modelled into its arms or shoulders (they cannot be taken off; the red panda and flamingo ones are the mildest: owner to decide)

source: branch asset-packs, folder ultimate-space-kit/ (uploaded by the owner, November 2026)
notes: Each astronaut holds a pistol as a separate mesh: it is removed (dropMeshes), and the gun clips are not kept.
The pack calls its aliens Enemy_*: they are staged as friendly aliens (alien-tiny, alien-flying, alien-big) with no punch, headbutt, hit or death clip.
There are four mechs and spaceships (bee, flamingo, frog, red panda) but only three astronauts: no red panda astronaut was uploaded.
